assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Create a clean landscape TWO-PANEL pixel art protagonist reference board. NO scarf, NO animal ears, NO muzzle, NO tail. Preserve the specific face and hair silhouette and clothing from the reference; do not invent a new generic mascot. Maintain coherent head neck shoulders torso arm and hand scale. No detached head or body-part collage. Overall STYLE is CUTE PIXEL ART: cohesive big-head short-limb proportions close to the identity reference, warm approachable expression, simplified rounded forms built with deliberate crisp stair-step pixel clusters, soft bright colors but HARD color blocks, 2-3 shade levels per material, minimal texture, dark selective outlines, not smooth anime painting. Left panel about 42 percent width: complete full-body character standing in the SAME relaxed pose as identity reference, facing slightly right, ears, hands and shoes fully visible, pale cream plain background. Right panel about 58 percent width: the SAME human protagonist at a simple cozy workshop desk, gently examining a small mint mechanical box, hands naturally contacting its lid, shelves and window behind. Match character/environment/prop pixel grain, proportion language and lighting. The room must be painted in the same cute pixel art, not realistic background with sprite pasted on. Calm daylight. One character per panel, identical identity and jacket. No foxes or other animals. No labels, no text, no watermarks. This is a new static candidate reference in the established human identity, not approved animation. Do not embed any explanatory UI components.
